blurb: West Salem Hockey Association (WSHA) is a non-profit organization based in West Salem, Wisconsin established in the mid 1970's. We are a founding member of the Wisconsin Minnesota Hockey League. We are dedicated to the promotion of youth ice hockey in the West Salem, Bangor, Rockland, and Mindoro areas.
